name: Scarlett Blackwood
source:
Also known as Red Riding Hood, Scarlett is an indomitable huntress with the beauty to match. Her tongue is as sharp as her dagger, and her love as great as the woods she grew up in.

[From [url=https://fictif.fandom.com/wiki/Isle_of_Enchantment]FictIf Wiki[/url]]
